scope: Read-only review of notebook 10 GNU Go adapter and notebook 11 arena integration

Subprocess timeout kills and reaps the child; no fallback is scored as a win or loss.

limitations.finding: An engine-specific timeout shorter than arena budget may be reported as UNKNOWN_PLAYER_ERROR rather than UNKNOWN_DEADLINE.
limitations.current_run_resolution: Current engine cap is 2 seconds and arena budget is 1 second; the shorter-cap case does not apply. Timeout outcome is always UNKNOWN.
limitations.future_fix: Classify explicit TimeoutError separately in a new arena version.
